grades.reasoning:
The agent successfully navigated to the official Labour Department website and accessed the specific page (EAO2025.htm) mentioned in the rubric via step 20. Through its interactions (particularly visible in screenshot 15), it located the "Q2. What is a continuous contract?" section. This section explicitly provides:
- The previous test: "employed continuously by the same employer for four weeks or more and has worked for at least 18 hours each week".
- The revised test: "employed continuously by the same employer for four weeks or more" and meeting either:
    (i) "worked for at least 17 hours in each week"
    (ii) "worked an aggregate of 68 hours or more across a 4-week period".
- The dates: The text notes the amendment was passed in 2025 and is "applicable from 18 January 2026".
- Onus of proof: The agent also located content in step 7 and 10 (confirmed in screenshot 7) stating: "the burden of proving that a contract of employment is not a continuous contract rests entirely on the employer."

The agent gathered all required pieces of information from official sources.
